audience: IT teams and service providers who patch and monitor endpoints in Action1

useCases.title: Find endpoints that are offline or need a reboot
useCases.text: List the organizations, then list the endpoints with status and reboot need. Open one endpoint for its OS and last-seen time.

useCases.title: List missing critical updates
useCases.text: List the updates that endpoints still miss, filtered by approval status and severity, across all organizations. Then list one package's updates to see the endpoints they affect.

useCases.title: Check whether a CVE affects your endpoints
useCases.text: List the CVEs found on endpoints, with CVSS score and deadline. Read one CVE for its CISA KEV flag, then list the endpoints it affects.

useCases.title: Review installed software and automation runs
useCases.text: List the software installed across the endpoints of one organization. List automation runs with their status and completion.

useCases.title: Read Action1 reports
useCases.text: List the report definitions your credentials can use. Read the rows of one report for one organization.
